g.text: The Five Engagement Modes of Legacy Modernization
Entry points sized to what the client is ready to commit to. Clients enter at any mode and may stop at any mode.
CLIENT MAY STOP AT ANY MODE · OR PROGRESS TO THE NEXT WHEN READY
Many clients stay at Documentation Only or Discovery indeﬁnitely. Most who reach Full Modernization continue into Maintain.
